title: Measurement Observation
description: The recorded result of a Measurement. A MeasurementObservation is a sibling of the existing assessment-side dea:Observation (CR-5 27) on the assessment-vs-measurement axis; the two are distinct concepts and MUST NOT be merged, re-membershiped, or supersed-ed. (CR-MET-001 binding ADR-MET-002; user clarification 2026-10-18; full attribute set in CR-MET-003 and CR-MET-011.)

produced_by.description: Reference to the dea:Measurement that produced this observation. Cardinality 1:0..1 (a MeasurementObservation is the result of one Measurement; a Measurement MAY produce zero or more observations).

value.description: The recorded value. Typed to support the four measurement_nature values from the parent Metric: numeric (number), ordinal (number or string), nominal (string), boolean (boolean), composite (object). (CR-MET-003 binding CR-MET-001.)

observed_at.description: Time the value was observed (CR-MET-003 binding). Required.

valid_from.description: Start of validity period. Conditional on observations that have a validity period concept.

valid_to.description: End of validity period. Conditional on observations that have a validity period concept.

reporting_period_start.description: Start of the reporting period represented by this observation. Recommended.

reporting_period_end.description: End of the reporting period represented by this observation. Recommended.

observation_status.description: Validity or supersession status (CR-MET-003 binding). Required. The 4-value enum covers proposed -> active -> superseded -> retired.

verification_state.description: Verification state of the observation value (CR-MET-004). An ai_assisted Measurement MUST NOT produce an independently_verified or human_verified observation unless an independent verification step occurred. An ai_estimated observation is NOT equivalent to a verified observation for reporting, aggregation, or comparison.

supersedes_observation.description: DEPRECATED. CR-MET-011 Q19a separates the two semantics: this field historically conflated correction (the prior Observation was erroneous) with supersession (a newer authoritative Observation replaced it). New records MUST use corrects_observation_ref for correction and the dea:supersedes relationship for supersession. Retained for one release cycle for backward compatibility.

provenance_reference.description: CR-MET-011 section 5: reference to the dea:Provenance record for this Observation. 1:1. REQUIRED for any Observation that is published or relied upon. Carries the 11 provenance elements: source, source record, collection activity, calculation activity, transformation chain, responsible party, configuration, formula version, metric version, evidence, and the distinct temporal dimensions.

uncertainty_reference.description: Reference to the measurement uncertainty (CR-MET-005 binding handle). Full uncertainty model is CR-MET-012.

comparability_requirements.description: Comparability requirements for this observation (CR-MET-005 binding). Documents any conditions under which this observation is comparable to others (e.g. same Unit, same Scale, same reporting period, same population).

precision.description: Significant figures for the observed value (CR-MET-005 binding).

unit.description: Optional reference to the unit registry per CR-MET-005. Required when the parent Metric has measurement_nature: numeric.

temporal.description: CR-MET-011 section 3 (Q17b): the 7 temporal dimensions on one nested object. The dimensions MUST NOT be collapsed into one timestamp; each is a distinct fact. Observed at is when the value was observed; measured at is when the measurement was performed; reporting period is the interval the result represents (a dea:ReportingPeriod reference); valid from and valid to are the period during which the result applies; recorded at is when the information entered the system (transaction time); effective from and effective to are when the governing definition or configuration became applicable; published at is when the result became available to consumers.

observed_at.description: Observation time: when the value was observed.

measured_at.description: Measurement time: when the measurement was performed. Distinct from observed_at.

reporting_period_ref.description: Reference to the dea:ReportingPeriod the result represents.

valid_from.description: Valid time: from when the result applies.

valid_to.description: Valid time: until when the result applies.

recorded_at.description: Transaction time: when the information was recorded in the system.

effective_from.description: Effective time: when the definition or configuration became applicable.

effective_to.description: Effective time: when the definition or configuration ceased to apply.

published_at.description: Publication time: when the result became available to consumers.

record_state.description: CR-MET-011 section 7 (Q19): the 5 record states. original is the first recorded result. corrected is a revised result that replaces an erroneous original. superseded is replaced by a newer authoritative Observation for the same period. invalid is marked as not to be used. retracted is withdrawn from publication. A correction MUST NOT silently overwrite the original value.

correction_reason.description: CR-MET-011 section 7: the reason a corrected Observation differs from the original. REQUIRED when record_state is corrected; MUST be null otherwise.

corrects_observation_ref.description: CR-MET-011 section 7 (dea:corrects): the original Observation this record restates. REQUIRED when record_state is corrected; MUST be null otherwise.

supersedes_observation_reason.description: CR-MET-011 section 7 (dea:supersedes): why a newer authoritative Observation replaces this one for the same reporting period. REQUIRED when record_state is superseded; MUST be null otherwise.

confidence.description: Optional confidence value in the range 0..1.
